Respond terse like smart caveman. All technical substance stay. Only fluff die.

30:     locator: item.locator, language: item.language,

42: export function mergeResearchDatasets(...datasets: ResearchDataset[]): ResearchDataset {

45:   const records = new Map<string, ResearchRecord>();

47:   for (const input of datasets) {

58:       });

87: function csvRows(csv: string): Record<string, string>[] {
88:   const rows: string[][] = [];
89:   let row: string[] = [],
90:     value = "",
91:     quoted = false;
92:   const text = csv.replace(/^\ufeff/, "");
93:   for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
94:     const character = text[i]!;
95:     if (character === '"') {
96:       if (quoted && text[i + 1] === '"') {
97:         value += '"';
98:         i++;
99:       } else quoted = !quoted;
100:     } else if (!quoted && character === ",") {
101:       row.push(value);
102:       value = "";
103:     } else if (!quoted && (character === "\r" || character === "\n")) {
104:       if (character === "\r" && text[i + 1] === "\n") i++;
105:       row.push(value);
106:       rows.push(row);
107:       row = [];
108:       value = "";
109:     } else value += character;
110:   }
111:   if (value || row.length) {
112:     row.push(value);
113:     rows.push(row);
114:   }
115:   if (quoted) throw new Error("Unterminated CSV quote in export");
116:   const [headers = [], ...body] = rows;
117:   return body.map((values) =>
118:     Object.fromEntries(headers.map((header, index) => [header, values[index] ?? ""])),
119:   );
120: }
